description: Moves a lead to another follow-up journey (segmentId, as Settings > Lead follow-ups names them: read the lead program), at the same place in the sequence, as the lead's journey tag does. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: move_lead_journey
